title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Transfer Learning for Plant Leaf Classification: Code and Reproduction Artifacts
description: Code, seed-level validation and held-out test metrics, and figure generators for an empirical study of hybrid quantum-classical transfer learning (frozen ImageNet ResNet18 with a PennyLane dressed variational-circuit head) on PlantVillage-derived leaf-image subsets. Includes classical baselines, a parameter-matched frozen linear head, a matched-width tanh head with the circuit removed, frozen-random-circuit and data re-uploading controls, a multi-seed circuit-depth ablation, a 50-epoch continuation, head learning-rate sweeps, and circuit-parameter gradient-variance diagnostics. PlantVillage images are not redistributed.
